criteria.saw_endpoint: Was a registered raw value for the assigned material actually delivered in the first opportunity window? Cite an M line or the explicit absence recorded at A.
criteria.citation: Does the accepted decision cite that source and use the correct concrete endpoint, material and reading? Cite the relevant M and A lines when present.
criteria.reason_scope: Does the scientific explanation support the decision for these observed coordinates under the preregistered threshold and limitations? Read negation and synonyms in context; a name, number or disposition alone is insufficient. Compare R with P and C.
criteria.action_reason: Did a concrete effect on the original comparison implement the stated reason? Cite R, I and A. A renamed branch, automatic Job or mere intention does not constitute reconsideration.

agreement: Only when two independently registered outcome readers both submit, report identical original item marks / four. Any disagreement or uncertainty awaits the registered arbitrator. Original signed reviews are retained.
denominators: Report interpreted/all originally assigned and scientifically passed/interpreted. Slots without a delivered opportunity or an eligible action, administrative stops, and pending review remain visible.
blinding: Packets omit condition code, run/arm labels, reviewer/actor identity, cost and delegation metadata. Wording, the observed value, actions or prior public knowledge can still suggest the condition or delegation.
scope: Descriptive archived-coordinate comparisons. Reasoned continuation, effective withdrawal/replacement or justified scientific stop can earn credit. Budget, time and operator stops remain administrative. Missing values or unverifiable observations remain explicit.
